correctness.rationale: From 18 ordered arcs of the fully bidirected K3,3, independently enumerated every 6-vertex directed linear forest by indegree<=1,outdegree<=1,directed acyclicity: exactly 715 augmented faces, f-vector (18,108,264,252,72). Reconstructed the declared 18-index simplex-toggle matching, found 342 augmented pairs and 31 critical higher faces; removed empty-face pair to get 341 ordinary pairs, one critical vertex, 19 critical 3-simplices and 12 critical 4-simplices. Independently checked acyclicity by topological sorting all 715 vertices of the directed Hasse graph with 2394 incidences. Executed exact signed integer Gaussian/Morse cancellation at 341 unit pivots, leaving zero higher Morse differentials; original mod-2 boundary ranks (1,17,91,173,60) independently recover Betti numbers. Since the CW 3-skeleton is wedge^19 S3 and pi3(wedge S3) maps isomorphically to H3, zero cellular 4-to-3 map implies each 4-cell attaches trivially. Thus wedge^19 S3 vee wedge^12 S4 is genuine integral homotopy, not a homology extrapolation.
